column1: # /Worksheet Global Format Hidden — workbook-wide default Hidden.
# Cells without a per-cell format render blank but the value is preserved
# in the control panel (and in formulas).
# /WGFH — set global format to Hidden. No decimals prompt, no POINT.
# A1 (no per-cell override) inherits the new global. Tag is (H); cell
# /WGFR resets the global back to General; the value reappears.
